name: Spicy Dan Dan Noodles with Chili Oil (Capsaicin Hazard)
whyItWorks: Wheat noodles drenched in fiery chili oil, Sichuan peppercorns, crushed peanuts, and minced pork. The combination of intense capsaicin, numbing peppers, and rough crushed peanuts is catastrophic during gut inflammation.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Extreme Danger Warning: Strictly avoid. The combination of peanuts, chili, and oil will irritate intestinal walls.
